# Case Status Dashboard

Updated: 2026-07-02

Mission: turn the tracker into an operational board: show what is open, what is verified, what needs a counter-source, what is privacy-blocked, and what record should be pulled next.

Boundary: Status is operational, not a verdict. A verified source route proves only the record it contains. Association is not guilt; open leads stay open until a source changes the confidence grade.

## Lane Status

1. Wrongdoing Tracker — critical — attach source records to each case type and separate confirmed findings from allegations and open leads.
2. Evidence Task Engine — critical — move tasks from open to pulled / verified / rejected as records are added.
3. Top 50 Evidence Pull List — high — connect pull list to every people, institution, money and speculation card.
4. Epstein Capital Class Map — critical — verify visible source-map nodes and classify each as map item only.
5. Billionaire / Wealth Tracker — high — add dated wealth source, filings, foundation route and public response lane.
6. Institution Tracker — high — add record-ready cards for banks, foundations, universities, law, media, tech, politics, property/entity and regulators.
7. Money Route Tracker — high — attach filing source, amount/date, recipient/sender, confidence and counter-source.
8. Aviation / Transport Evidence — medium — keep historical-only and attach court exhibits, registry context and privacy notes.
9. Dark Speculation Lab — medium — add one proving source and one counter-source route to each high-risk claim.
10. Weekly Black File Funnel — conversion — route email readers into Tracker Dashboard, Wrongdoing Tracker, Pull List and Source Vault.
